_about: John Scott Haldane (1860-1936), physiologist and philosopher of biology, brother of R. B. Haldane (shelf r-b-haldane). Raw IA OCR: Mechanism, Life and Personality, an examination of the mechanistic theory of life and mind (London: John Murray, 1913), Organism and Environment as illustrated by the physiology of breathing (New Haven: Yale, 1917) and The New Physiology and other addresses (London: Griffin, 1919). Wanted: The Sciences and Philosophy (Gifford Lectures, 1929); the only scan found is access-restricted. His technical works on respiration and mine air are not taken. US public domain. No uids minted.
